content.short: WalletX is Solana's wallet analyzer, offering thousands of profitable wallets for copy trading.
content.description: WalletX helps you identify profitable wallets on Solana to copy trade, saving time and effort spent finding successful wallets to copy. By providing access to thousands of curated wallets, WalletX supports users in maximizing profits and refining their copy trading strategies. The free plan offers one weekly alpha wallet and five checks per day, while the premium plan unlocks hundreds of alpha wallets daily and infinite checks.
